dialogue.text: [warm, wry] Keep an eye on that pen, because before closing time, somebody in this bank is going to get a very different one.

[warm, storytelling] Level two is three hundred dollars, and the first customer is a waitress. She gets paid in cash tips and paper checks, so nothing ever lands in her account automatically. And her account has a rule: keep fifteen hundred dollars in it, set up direct deposit, or pay twelve dollars every month.
So every month I pay you twelve bucks to hold my three hundred?
How do I make it stop?
